# NERC Grid Map

[Open the live map →](https://willschenk.github.io/nerc-grid-map/)

A browser-based map of North American bulk power system organizations registered with the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC). It turns the NERC compliance registry into a visual reference: organizations are geocoded and plotted on an interactive map, sized by the weighted importance of their reliability roles and colored by the mix of functions they perform. The goal is to make the electric grid landscape easier to understand at a glance than a spreadsheet of acronyms.

_Note: this project is an independent visualization; it is not an official NERC product and must not be used as a compliance source of truth._

## What is the NERC registry?

The NERC registry identifies and registers bulk power system users, owners, and operators responsible for performing specified reliability functions. Registered entities must comply with mandatory NERC Reliability Standards. Roles in the registry include Balancing Authority (BA), Transmission Operator (TOP), Reliability Coordinator (RC) and others.

## Visual encoding: size and color

The map uses simple encodings to communicate how much responsibility each organization holds and what kinds of functions it performs:

- **Size**: Each circle is scaled according to the sum of the weights of the organization’s registered reliability roles. Roles that have systemic impact—such as Reliability Coordinator (RC)—carry a larger weight than more limited roles like Distribution Provider (DP). The weights and full names are defined in [`src/lib/nerc/roles.mjs`](src/lib/nerc/roles.mjs).

- **Color**: The hue of each circle reflects the mix of reliability functions. Pure hues represent organizations that perform a single role category (for example a primarily Transmission Operator is shown in one color), while mixed hues indicate organizations with multiple roles. Roles are grouped into categories (operational control, planning, compliance, etc.) and assigned anchor colors; organizations with several roles interpolate between these anchors.

The legend below illustrates the approximate size and color mapping used on the map. Larger circles correspond to entities with more critical roles, and colors blend when multiple categories apply:

![Reliability roles legend](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Phase 1 of this project aims to perfect this ingest‑to‑map workflow and to improve location research, QA checks, and payload health rather than adding new features. Compliance‑duty modelling or other downstream interpretations are intentionally out of scope until the registry data and map workflow are consistently trustworthy.

## Run locally

Requires Node.js >=20.3.0.

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Other useful commands:

```bash
npm run build      # build the static site
npm run check      # Astro + TypeScript checks
npm run nerc:qa    # data QA checks
npm run deploy     # deploy to GitHub Pages
```

## Key files

```text
src/pages/index.astro              page markup
src/lib/nerc/map/nerc-org-map.ts   D3 map client
src/lib/nerc/map/nerc-org-map.css  map styles
src/lib/nerc/roles.mjs             role weights, names, colors
src/lib/nerc/enrich.mjs            build-time enrichment
scripts/nerc/                      ingest, build, QA, research prompt
src/data/nerc/                     source and researched records
public/nerc/                       generated map JSON and basemap
```

Contributor and pipeline rules live in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Organization label policy lives in [docs/standards/name-shortest.md](docs/standards/name-shortest.md).
